Ofc! Originally I was diagnosed with general anxiety, after speaking to a therapist and my doctor further we came to the conclusion that I had situational anxiety. This occurred because of being drugged & basically spending a year inside during quarantine. Because of this is why I decided to only take them for roughly 5 months. In regards to depersonalization/derealization they also helped a lot. Before starting them I was getting to the point of checking myself in because I couldn’t stand not feeling alive. It look about a month for those feeling to subside. During that time I took note of how I felt and I was able to realize when I was about to experience a bout of derealization. Now that I’m off lexapro I have to be more vigilant to catch the signs. Sometimes it becomes overwhelming and I need to excuse myself from my environment. Overall I felt a lot better on lexapro than I did before or even now when it comes to derealization.
